priority.summary: Fermi Inc. discloses the immediate resignation of director Miles Everson, effective July 10, 2026, due to a disagreement over access to company books and records and the delegation of responsibility for overseeing financing transactions to the Finance Committee. Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., disclosed that the company has dropped its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment, after a Texas Business Court ordered the company to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw.
